hardwareAudit.newFinding: Official hardware net connectivity and pinned XMOS reference ingestion establish that the existing native playback route is wired to the AEC reference. This is stronger than the previous microphone-stage configuration inspection.

capture.note: MicrophoneSource conversion/channel selection is reused exactly by EvaMicrophoneSource; native microphone capture remains enabled during firmware output. Host echo fence discards submitted input while output is busy.

outputReference.nativePath: eva_duplex_resampling_speaker → eva_duplex_mixing_input → mixing_speaker → i2s_audio_speaker, 48 kHz stereo, GPIO10
outputReference.electricalNet: GPIO10 connects through a series zero-ohm resistor to I2S_DIN_SEC. This net reaches XMOS X1D00/XS1_PORT_1A and AIC3204 SCLK/MFP3.
outputReference.xmosPath: I2S_MIC_DATA/PORT_I2S_ADC_DATA → i2s1 RX → 48-to-16 kHz decimator → audio_pipeline_input first two reference channels → AEC stage
outputReference.dacConfiguration: The compiled AIC3204 driver selects secondary SCLK data input using page0 registers31=1 and32=1. Native speaker PCM therefore reaches both DAC and XMOS reference on the same net.
